about: Point 1-4 (id fortress; Henry, Nov 23-24; modern military theme): four teams attack each other's bases. Created with LM2, a student. Questions come from Quiz Dash's bank, Battle of Wits sets or a unit; this file only holds the How to play slides.

intro.title: Point 1-4
text: One HQ and four buildings: defend your base, attack the others.
Answer questions to win weapons, repairs and gold!

rows: 10,000 HP: lose it and you are out

intro.title: Weapons
text: Right answer: choose a weapon, a repair or gold.
Harder question = better weapons!

intro.title: The store
text: After every team has had a turn: Haishi Trade Company opens.
Then fire your weapons at any enemy base!

rows: keep it: fixes or rebuilds a building

intro.title: Defend your base
text: Towers shoot weapons down: [LQ] always, [Q] 16%, [HQ] 8%.
HQ destroyed? Use a repair kit or sacrifice a building!

rows: one tower gone = half the chance
kit or sacrifice, or you are out

intro.title: Power-ups
text: One of each per team, once per game.
Question Change: swap for a Hard or Impossible question!

intro.title: Made with LM2
text: Point 1-4 was created with LM2,
a student who helped design the game. Thank you, LM2!

rows: last base, or the strongest after the rounds

introSmash.title: SMASH
text: Four teams attack each other's bases.
Answer a question, then FIRE right away!

rows: 3,200 HP: lose it and you are out

introSmash.title: Right answer = fire!
text: The harder the question, the bigger the weapon.
Pick one, then tap the base you want to hit.

introSmash.title: Armor, not luck
text: Nothing gets shot down! Each standing tower blocks 15%.
The menu shows exactly how much damage you will do.

introSmash.title: Streaks and Risk It
text: 3 right answers in a row unlock the RS-28 Sarmat!
Risk It: 1.5x damage, but a wrong answer hurts.

introSmash.title: Repair or attack
text: Not in the mood to fight? Pick Repair instead.
If your HQ falls, sacrifice a building to fight on.

rows: fix any building, even rebuild one
sacrifice a building or you are out
join a team and share its points

rows: last base, or the strongest after 6 rounds
